How Listening Quotas & the Emergency Reserve Work

Kavach never streams quiet room audio. Our local browser worklet only uploads speech frames when continuous conversation is detected over speakerphone. A typical household taking 2–3 unfamiliar courier or delivery calls a week uses fewer than 40 minutes per month.

Silence Gating (Zero Burn)
Room silence and everyday background household TV/noise do not deplete your monthly minutes.
Emergency Reserve Guarantee
If an active scam call is detected and monthly quota is exhausted, Kavach seamlessly draws from the reserve so protection never drops mid-incident.
